newsitem.title: USA: Most IMM currencies end down, sterling up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Most IMM currencies end down, sterling up sharply.

text.p: Oct 15 - IMM currency futures ended mostly lower under the weight of strong dollar and technical weakness. December sterling rallied sharply, reaching contract high at $1.5890. Sterling options action brisk in afternoon trade. Several traders noted buying of 2,500 March 1.52/1.60 strangles and seller of at least 2,000 November 1.56/1.58 strangles. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
